title: Data Structures and Algorithms
instructor: Marcus Darden, Hector Garcia, Maximilian Krogius, David Paoletti
skills: code correctness under hidden test cases
workloadNotes: 10 lab assignments (20% total) and 4 projects (40% total, 2-3 weeks each) across the semester, plus a midterm and final exam (20% each). Minimum competency thresholds apply separately to projects (55%), exams (50%), and labs (75%). Two late days allowed for the semester.
prerequisitesText: Grade of C or better in each of EECS 203 and EECS 280 (or equivalent knowledge of discrete mathematics and C++ programming); MATH 465 or MATH 565 accepted in lieu of EECS 203. Strictly enforced; two-attempt limit on EECS 281 itself.
textbooks: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, and Stein, Introduction to Algorithms, 3rd ed., MIT Press, 2009
N. Josuttis, The C++ Standard Library: A Tutorial and Reference, 2nd ed., Addison Wesley, 2012
